verdict.rationale: Featurebase pairs a support inbox covering in-app, Slack, Discord and email conversations with a feedback portal it says centralizes insights 'with integrations'. It also claims AI for finding impactful opportunities, which puts conversation data and feedback in one place. However, no evidence shows feedback being automatically extracted from tickets or chats, and sales calls are never mentioned. Missing for 10: automatic detection or extraction of feedback from support tickets and chat conversations, sales-call ingestion (e.g., call-recording integrations), documentation of how conversation-to-feedback capture works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
